cpu.description: Peak CPU of the next run, in normalized compute units

memory.description: Peak memory of the next run, normalized by the trace publisher

evaluation_scope: One-time final test: each test run's recommendation is compared with the next run of the same workload.
caveats: CPU and memory are normalized by the trace publisher: values can be compared between policies but cannot be converted to cores or gigabytes.
User and job names are hashed in the trace, so workload names are identifiers, not readable names.
Results replay the historical test period once: each recommendation is compared with what the next run of the same workload actually used. They are not measurements from a live cluster.
